hazards.title: Worker beneath suspended load
hazards.description: The signal person in the orange vest at center stands almost directly beneath the steel bundle suspended from the crane, inside the load's fall zone.

hazards.title: Lift area not barricaded
hazards.description: No barricades, cones or exclusion-zone markings are visible around the lift path, so workers can move freely under and around the suspended steel.

hazards.title: Loose bundle in basket slings
hazards.description: The suspended bundle of steel tubes and beams is held only by two basket-hitch slings with no visible banding, so individual members could shift or slide out during the lift.

hazards.title: Workers near crane swing radius
hazards.description: A worker stands next to the mobile crane carrier and outriggers on the right, within the crane's swing area, with no barricade marking the counterweight zone.

hazards.title: Haphazard steel piles on ground
hazards.description: In the foreground, steel tubes and channels are piled loosely and crosswise on each other and on timber, so they could roll or topple.

hazards.title: Materials and debris in walkway
hazards.description: Loose timber, steel offcuts and tools are scattered across the work surface in the lower foreground, creating trip hazards where workers walk.

hazards.title: Slings left on ground
hazards.description: Lifting slings lie in a tangled pile on the ground in the lower foreground, creating a trip hazard and exposing the rigging gear to damage.
